fix_subject: Correctly deal with impossible implicit casts from array -> list
pr_title: Fix various fuzzer issues, move fuzzer scripts into this repo, and expand `reduce_sql_statement` to improve test case reduction capabilities of fuzzer

labels.summary: ImplicitCast from ARRAY to LIST returned a cost of 0 (the impossible child cast's -1 plus 1) instead of reporting the cast as impossible, so an impossible array-to-list implicit cast was treated as viable; the fix returns -1 when the child cast is impossible.
